settings.title: Is the Q5 Shark  legal to ride in the US?
settings.text:
Yes. The Q5 Shark is set to Class 1 eBike mode by default, with pedal assist up to 20 MPH, making it legal on most US bike paths, city streets, and public trails.

For private property or off-road use, riders can adjust the speed settings. Please follow local laws and regulations when riding.

settings.title: How far can I ride on one charge?
settings.text: Up to 75 miles depending on pedal assist level, rider weight, terrain, and riding style. Most riders get 40–60 miles in real-world commuting.

settings.title: Can I remove the battery for charging?
settings.text: Yes. The battery is removable, so you can charge it on or off the bike for convenience.

settings.title: What rider height does it fit?
How much weight can it carry?
